lines.t: I walked through the silence, searching for a sign,
A whisper in the darkness, a promise through time.
Though shadows tried to steal the light I knew,
Every step brought me closer to the truth.
Faith is the fire that never dies,
The voice that calls beyond the skies.
Through every storm, through doubt and fear,
I feel Your presence drawing near.
Mountains tremble, oceans rise and fall,
Still I hear Your love above it all.
The Word is living, breathing through my soul,
Breaking these chains, making me whole.
Faith is the fire that never dies,
The voice that calls beyond the skies.
Through every storm, through doubt and fear,
I feel Your presence drawing near.
When the world grows dim, and hope runs thin,
Your truth ignites the light within.
I’ll walk by trust, not by my sight,
Guided home by Your endless light.
Faith is the fire that never dies,
The voice that calls beyond the skies.
Your word endures, Your promise clear,
Forever You're the one I’ll hear.
